A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Know what to expect.

Something else on your mind?
Text Rob your question.

What does the $175 special cover?

The offer is for new driveway-cleaning customers through December 1, 2026. Send your address so Rob can confirm whether your driveway qualifies and what is included. Size, condition, extra areas and specialty stain treatments can affect the final quote.

Do I need to know my driveway size?

No. Send your property address and Rob can help estimate the area. If you know the size, the optional calculator shows standard starting rates. The new-customer special is confirmed separately.

Will every stain come out?

Results depend on the concrete and the stain. General dirt and organic buildup are different from oil, rust or paint. Rob will discuss any stubborn stains before you book; cleaning does not repair cracks or damaged concrete.

Can you clean my sidewalk too?

Yes. Include the sidewalk, front walk or patio in your request so Rob can quote all the areas together.
